The HTTPS client embeds these root trust anchors for a deliberately small
initial trust store. The anchor data was generated with BearSSL v0.6's
`brssl ta` command from the official self-signed root certificates:

- Google Trust Services GTS Root R1
  https://pki.goog/repo/certs/gtsr1.pem
- Internet Security Research Group ISRG Root X1
  https://letsencrypt.org/certs/isrgrootx1.pem

The certificates were valid through 2036 and 2035 respectively when vendored.
The HTTPS client still checks certificate validity dates and hostnames. Add
additional roots only by reviewing and regenerating the trust-anchor table.
